title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Researcher Agent Access
description: Allows developers to invoke the Researcher agent through the Work IQ endpoint to perform multi‑step analysis, deep reasoning, and synthesis across enterprise content as part of agentic workflows.
